description: This file contains shell script functions for upgrading and flashing Zyxel devices. It includes methods to get root filesystem, perform flash operations, and orchestrate the upgrade process for specific Zyxel models, with steps involving device setup, image extraction, flashing, and device reboot.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Retrieves the root filesystem device from the kernel command line parameters.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Handles flashing the kernel and root filesystem from a tar archive to specified device nodes, including formatting and configuration backup.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Coordinates the upgrade process for Zyxel devices by selecting appropriate partitions based on the device state and invoking the flashing routine.
